Hi Samir —

Great to meet yesterday. Quick follow-up from our discovery/demo with next steps to unblock contracting and payment setup. I want to make sure we capture Finex's preferred procurement path so we can expedite pricing and vendor onboarding.

Summary of options we usually see (quick, for reference):
- Credit card (P-card): fastest to start; smaller purchase orders; limited paperwork.
- Purchase order (PO) + invoice: standard for finance teams; requires vendor packet (W-9/W-8, banking details), legal review.
- Cloud marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure): works if you want consolidated billing and marketplace listing; timing depends on marketplace onboarding.

Action items for you:
1) Which payment path is preferred for this initial pilot (card, PO, marketplace)?
2) Who is the procurement contact who will complete the vendor packet?
3) Do you have any vendor portal we should submit documents into, or should we return a completed vendor packet to procurement@finexanalytics.com?

I attached a short vendor packet we can return filled or drop into your portal. If PO is the route, we typically ask for: W-9 (U.S.) or W-8 (non-U.S.), banking instructions (ACH/Wire), business contact for invoice routing, and a suggested PO number format.

Next week Jordan can help surface any commercial questions and Monica will coordinate legal and finance handoffs once we have a path.

Thanks — quick reply with the payment preference would be perfect.

Best,
